ItemID: NA; Title: Kid A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its electronic, atmospheric direction is less appealing than the heavier rock I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Marshall Mathers       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for guitar-driven rock and metal rather than hip-hop this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: No Strings Attached; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Polished pop does not fit my current interest in heavier music.
ItemID: NA; Title: X&Y; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its softer rock sound is less compelling given my recent heavier selections.
ItemID: NA; Title: American Idiot Import       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its energetic guitars and melodic hooks appeal to the side of my taste reflected by Chuck.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Young and the Hopeless; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic punk sound fits some of my history, but I would prioritize the Tool albums today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Piper at the Gates of Dawn; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its psychedelic sound is less closely matched to the hard rock and metal I currently want.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I would choose more Tool for the heavy riffs and intricate rhythms.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in 10.000 Days makes another immersive, rhythmically complex Tool album especially appealing.
ItemID: NA; Title: How to Dismantle An Atomic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its anthemic rock is less aligned with the heavier, more intricate music I am seeking today.
